Restore +2 hull. Gain +1 credit after each mission.

Black Filter
Filters 1 black node per mission into a white node.
Filters 2 black nodes per mission into white nodes.
Filters 3 black nodes per mission into white nodes.
White Upgrade
On each flush, 1 white node becomes blue.
On each flush, 1 white node becomes red.
On each flush, 1 white node becomes red and 1 white node becomes blue.
Time Buffer

Mission duration +10 sec. More time, more score opportunities, more risk.
Mission duration +15 sec. More time, more score opportunities, more risk.
Medal Cash

Earn bonus credits from medals. Bronze +3 / Silver +6 / Gold +9.
Earn bonus credits from medals. Bronze +4 / Silver +7 / Gold +10.
K0 Drone Control
All drones start the mission fully charged.
All drones start charged and their cooldown is reduced by 10%.
All drones start charged and their cooldown is reduced by 20%.
K1 Anti-Black Drone
After a 30 sec recharge, uses its laser to neutralize the nearest black ball.
After a 23 sec recharge, uses its laser to neutralize the nearest black ball.
After an 18 sec recharge, uses its laser to neutralize the nearest black ball.
K2 Drone Interceptor
After a 30 sec recharge, rescues a white ball before it falls into the Void.
After a 25 sec recharge, rescues a white or blue ball before it falls into the Void.
After a 22 sec recharge, rescues a white, blue, or red ball before it falls into the Void.
